threshold_rule: largest observed calibration score whose score >= cutoff predictions reach the target; retain all ties; no interpolation or randomization

calibration_split.source: original fit patients only; use one fixed held-out fold for calibration, other four for fitting

sampling.method: retain every subfit ECG then duplicate minority with replacement to equal class counts

models.settings: inherit balanced-v1 classifiers, epochs and learning schedules unchanged; refit all learned preprocessing on unique subfit records only

bootstrap.unit: patient with all their ECGs retained
bootstrap.interval: pointwise paired percentile 95%; average seed metrics, not scores
bootstrap.saved_scores: reselect threshold in each resampled validation curve; descriptive, not independent evaluation
bootstrap.new_fits: hold calibration thresholds fixed and resample validation patients; excludes fitting and calibration uncertainty

reporting: all per-seed thresholds and confusion counts
limits: ECG-level outcomes on patient-disjoint internal validation previously examined in earlier research. Calibration targets are not guarantees on validation. Fewer fitting patients than the earlier study. No clinical or quantum advantage claim. No new exclusions or waveform extraction.
